Horatio Alger National Career and Technical Scholarship Program

Students can receive up to $2,500 to pursue career or technical education.

Eligibility Requirements:

  • Have completed high school (or earned high school equivalency credential) 
  • Be enrolled in a 2-year or less career or technical degree/certificate program that will lead to employment
  • Attend a not-for-profit post-secondary institution
  • Demonstrate financial need; applicants must be eligible to receive the Federal Pell grant
  • Be under the age of 30
  • Be a United States Citizen

To learn more about the scholarship, eligibility requirements, or to apply online, visit scholars.horatioalger.org.
